name: Phase 2 systems design (machines & delegation begins)
summary: Phase 2 is where the delegation arc starts paying off: the sprinkler graduates from a single machine to a system, crow pressure scales from lone birds to flocks, and evenings may become social time. A six-turn progression straw-man (bare yard to first tower) is drafted; the systems design behind it needs to firm up before M3 planning can borrow from it.
requirements: Phase 2 design chapter drafted: machines, flock scaling, decoys, the evening question
Each new mechanic traced to the saturation-mastery-relief loop ruling
Sim-layer feasibility notes from Engineering on each proposed system
CEO ruling on the phase 2 opening questions (evenings, flock dial, acorn economy)
current_status: The progression straw-man (six turns of the cycle) is committed. The bestiary, sprinkler, scent fields, and bot configs already exist in the sim behind flags — phase 2 design is partly 'decide how to turn on what's built.' Design drafting is active but early.

plan.step: M2.5 shipped the mechanical substrate (sprinkler, scent, brains, bot configs)
Write the phase 2 design chapter with open questions flagged for ruling
CEO rules; design feeds M3 (or M4) scope

plan_note: Plan is intentionally incomplete — later steps depend on which milestone picks up phase 2 content.
